Author: KeydenK
Name: Beeline
Punchline: Point at anything on your map and press one button: Beeline takes you there the quickest way.
Description: Point at anything on your map and press one button (controller, mouse or keyboard): Beeline takes you there the quickest way, picking between walking, the aethernet or a teleport, then mounting, flying and walking the rest for you. Made for questing: quest markers are used at their exact position, so you end up right next to the quest NPC or object, targeted and ready to talk to, and at a safe distance from quest enemies. Works on aetherytes, aethernet shards, quest and leve markers, quest areas and any spot, in any zone. Moving your character stops the trip at once. Requires Lifestream and vnavmesh. Command: /beeline
Changelog: Mouse clicks now work on an unfocused map: Beeline works out the spot under the mouse from the map's view itself, instead of the game's cursor position, which only updates while the map is focused. New option to save gil: turn off paid teleports on the map you're already on (the free aethernet shards are still used). Many more things are now hit exactly: FATEs, party members, your flag, housing plots, temporary markers (treasure maps...) and the map's own icons (shops, guilds, exits...). In gathering areas you walk up to the nearest gathering point, and housing district aethernet shards are used from a shard of the same district.
